newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio sees good demand for wet end system.
newsitem.headline: Raisio sees good demand for wet end system.

text.p: Finnish foodstuffs, animal feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy sees good demand for its recently launched paper machine wet end analysing system, a company executive said on Wednesday.
"I expect that every new paper machine or renewal will include this type of device," Tor Bergman, managing director of Raisio Chemicals, told a seminar.

He declined to give a sales target for the new product -- the WIC 100 analysing system used by the paper industry to control a paper machine's wet end -- but said 50 to 100 new paper machines are expected to be built annually in the next few years.
The unit price of Raisio's device is some four million markka. Raisio has so far sold 10 such units, he said.
Pertti Pursiheimo, general manager at Raisio's wet end systems unit, said Raisio expects the system to be a strong profit generator as it is a high-margin niche product which has no competitors.
"Margins are quite good," he said, but did not elaborate.
